name: Tattoo Shop Simulator
summary:
Your chair. Your needles. Your reputation.

REAL TATTOOING, LINE BY LINE
Grab the stencil from the thermal printer and press it onto your customer's forearm - the purple transfer appears right where you put it. Dip the rotary pen in black and trace it. The machine buzzes to life the moment the needle touches skin. A light touch draws a fine line, a firm press lays a bold one, and pushing too deep makes your customer wince.

PACK THE COLOUR
Switch to the coil machine, dip it in each ink the design calls for
